scripts.start:https: NITRO_SSL_CERT="$(cat data/tls/cert.pem)" NITRO_SSL_KEY="$(cat data/tls/key.pem)" HOST=0.0.0.0 PORT=3000 node .output/server/index.mjs
scripts.cert: mkdir -p data/tls && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -days 3650 -subj /CN=evening-mix -keyout data/tls/key.pem -out data/tls/cert.pem
